targets.ds:136:199:Dialogue Text: [pic=5]Звучи добре! Имаме още много за оправяне. Играта на думи е нарочна.

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=3]So back to the original idea then?
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=3]Значи се връщаме към първоначалната идея?

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=5]I definitely think that’s our lightning in a bottle!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=5]Определено мисля, че това е ударът ни в десетката!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=4]Let’s ask Red!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=4]Да попитаме Ред!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=5]Wanna hear our next million dollar idea? Don’t steal it!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=5]Искаш ли да чуеш следващата ни идея за милиони? Да не я откраднеш!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: Sure, lay it on me!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: Разбира се, давайте!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=3]Ya ever get tired getting off to the same old same old?
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=3]Писва ли ти да свършваш все от едно и също?

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=3]Oh, we should add a matching service as well! We can take notes of kinks, and offer to hook up others interested in similar stuff!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=3]О, трябва да добавим и услуга за запознанства! Ще записваме фетишите и ще предлагаме да свързваме онези със сходни интереси!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=5]Oh that’s good stuff right there! Perhaps we could set up meets for the more popular kinks! We can even feature guests who’re enthusiasts!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=5]О, това е добра идея! Може да организираме срещи за по-популярните фетиши! Дори ще каним гости ентусиасти!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=4]That would be a great way for folks to learn about new experiences!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=4]Така всички ще могат да научат за нови изживявания!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=3]Something tells me, they might just turn into orgies…
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=3]Нещо ми подсказва, че просто ще се превърнат в оргии…

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=3]Want some spice in your love life?
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=3]Искаш ли малко пикантност в любовния живот?

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=4]Look no further! The Kink Finders have your back!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=4]Не търси повече! Търсачите на фетиши са насреща!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: The Kink Finders???
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: Търсачите на фетиши???

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=4]Nothing wrong with that!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=4]Няма нищо лошо в това!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=1]Yep! It’s our latest workshopped project!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=1]Да! Това е най-новият проект, който разработваме!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=5]See Red, Mabel and I spitball project ideas every so often. We wanted to figure out something that could capitalize on the current trend in the forest!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=5]Виж, Ред, с Мейбъл от време на време си подхвърляме идеи. Искахме да измислим как да спечелим от сегашната мода в гората!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: Current trend?
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: Сегашната мода?

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=4]Why the Love of course!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=4]Ами любовта, разбира се!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=1]Thanks to you, Critters have been sleeping around more these days!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=1]Благодарение на теб животинките напоследък спят с повече различни партньори!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=4]That’s right!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=4]Точно така!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=5]And what better way to make some extra coin, than offering a related service!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=5]А какъв по-добър начин да изкараме още монети от свързана с това услуга!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=3]We figure there’s bound to be some sexual avenues some critters have been wanting to explore, or are curious about, but were never able to.
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=3]Сигурно има сексуални неща, които някои животинки отдавна искат да опитат или са им любопитни, но не са могли.

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=5]Or kinks they didn’t even know existed!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=5]Или фетиши, за които дори не са чували!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=4]Yeah Maverick didn’t know what sounding was until just a moment ago!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=4]Да, Маверик до преди малко не знаеше какво е уретрално сондиране!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=3]Ya ever hear of it Red?
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=3]Чувал ли си за него, Ред?

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=1]Something going IN your ding-dong??
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=1]Нещо да влиза ВЪТРЕ в пишката ти??

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=2]I still don’t believe it! That can’t be a thing, no way!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=2]Още не мога да повярвам! Няма такова нещо, няма начин!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: It’s a thing!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: Има!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=3]Definitely a thing!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=3]Определено има!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=2]Let’s just say there are some advantages to being so small…
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=2]Да кажем, че да си толкова малка има своите предимства…

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=3]Hmm!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=3]Хмм!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=3]I’ll have to remember that one…
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=3]Трябва да го запомня…

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=1]OK, Let’s move forward with the idea. We’ll need to come up with the logistics next… Are we charging folks for our consultation time?
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=1]Добре, да продължим с идеята. Следват организационните въпроси… Ще таксуваме ли времето за консултация?

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=5]Of course!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=5]Разбира се!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=3]Will there be “hands on” options for the service?
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=3]Ще предлагаме ли и „практически“ услуги?

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=7]Hmm good question… That would certainly make things a lot more fun…
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=7]Хмм, добър въпрос… Определено би било много по-забавно…

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=3]That would feel weird to charge for…
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=3]Би ми било странно да взимаме пари за това…

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=4]Maybe those options would be a bonus!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=4]Може да са бонус!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=3]Hmm!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=3]Хмм!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: OK! I’ll let you guys get to it.
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: Добре! Ще ви оставя да действате.

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=5]Sounds good! We got plenty of kinks to iron out. Pun intended.
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=5]Звучи добре! Имаме още много за оправяне. Играта на думи е нарочна.

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=4]Take care Rascal! Maybe you can be a guinea pig for us once we get the ball rolling!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=4]Пази се, Раскал! Като потръгне, може ти да ни бъдеш опитно зайче!

decision.reason: 169:194 craves beaver after Scarlett recalls Barnaby and Peter;195 rejects the vagina interpretation. Bulgarian бобър alone does not supply the English slang sense. Naming the quoted word in the denial makes that relation intelligible while preserving the actual animal/partner desire. It neither claims that this is established Bulgarian slang nor changes the setup or Bucky's identity. This is a complete replacement including the original picture control.

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: Bucky
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: Бъки

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=3]Oh good ole Barnaby!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=3]О, добрият стар Барнаби!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=2]He and I have been neighbors forever. He’s so helpful and handy!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=2]Открай време сме съседи. Толкова е услужлив и сръчен!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=3]I’ve had him over many times to fix up the house! He’s always happy to be of service.
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=3]Много пъти съм го канила да оправи нещо по къщата! Винаги помага с радост.

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=1]… Y’know…
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=1]… Знаеш ли…

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=3]Despite him favoring the male critters, he used to swing with my husband and I back in the day!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=3]Макар да предпочита мъжките животинки, навремето се забавлявахме тримата с мъжа ми!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=2]It’s clear he was in it more for my husband, but he was a gentleman to me all the same!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=2]Ясно е, че го правеше повече заради мъжа ми, но и към мен беше джентълмен!

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=1]All this talk has got me craving beaver…
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=1]От толкова приказки ми се прииска бобър…

fullSourceTargetGroup.source: [pic=1]…and I don’t mean vagina!
fullSourceTargetGroup.target: [pic=1]… И под „бобър“ нямам предвид вагина!

decision.reason: The complete three-line examinations compare the lilac's beauty and the bluebells' scent to their unnamed planter. Bulgarian този, който can be generic masculine and does not prove a male planter. Nevertheless it is an avoidable personal gender marker under the supplied neutrality rule. The approved world term животинка supplies grammatical agreement without naming or sexing the planter. Preserve singular tree versus plural flowers and the second line's probability.
